vecadd.test:
def _test_size(sz):
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.rand(sz, dtype=torch.float32)
    y = torch.rand(sz, dtype=torch.float32)
    assert torch.allclose(add(x, y), x + y), f"size={sz} failed"

# zero-size tensor
_test_size(0)
# single-element tensor
_test_size(1)
# just under the block size (1024)
_test_size(1023)
# exact block size
_test_size(1024)
# one element over the block size
_test_size(1025)
# non-contiguous tensors (transpose)
torch.manual_seed(42)
x = torch.randn(64, 64)
y = torch.randn(64, 64)
xt, yt = x.t(), y.t()
assert torch.allclose(add(xt, yt), xt + yt), "non-contiguous transpose failed"
